certification_scope: Repository-reviewed demonstration definitions; not enterprise Finance signoff

metrics.business_definition: Sum of posted invoice revenue after discounts, before physical returns; excludes tax and freight.
metrics.calculation: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Revenue),0) FROM FactSales WHERE DateKey BETWEEN :start AND :end
metrics.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Revenue),0) FROM FactSales WHERE DateKey BETWEEN :start AND :end
metrics.filters: Through configured business cutoff; posted invoices only where applicable
metrics.exclusions: No taxes, freight, rebates, GL balances or credit-note accounting

metrics.business_definition: Posted invoice revenue minus generated line COGS; excludes rebates and overhead.
metrics.calculation: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GrossProfit),0) FROM FactSales WHERE DateKey BETWEEN :start AND :end
metrics.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GrossProfit),0) FROM FactSales WHERE DateKey BETWEEN :start AND :end
metrics.filters: Through configured business cutoff; posted invoices only where applicable
metrics.exclusions: No taxes, freight, rebates, GL balances or credit-note accounting

metrics.business_definition: Aggregate gross profit divided by aggregate posted invoice revenue. Undefined at zero revenue.
metrics.calculation: SELECT SUM(GrossProfit)/NULLIF(SUM(Revenue),0) FROM FactSales WHERE DateKey BETWEEN :start AND :end
metrics.sql: SELECT SUM(GrossProfit)/NULLIF(SUM(Revenue),0) FROM FactSales WHERE DateKey BETWEEN :start AND :end
metrics.filters: Through configured business cutoff; posted invoices only where applicable
metrics.exclusions: No taxes, freight, rebates, GL balances or credit-note accounting

metrics.business_definition: Sum of quantity on posted invoice lines.
metrics.calculation: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Quantity),0) FROM FactSales WHERE DateKey BETWEEN :start AND :end
metrics.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Quantity),0) FROM FactSales WHERE DateKey BETWEEN :start AND :end
metrics.filters: Through configured business cutoff; posted invoices only where applicable
metrics.exclusions: No taxes, freight, rebates, GL balances or credit-note accounting

metrics.business_definition: Distinct order headers by order date, including open and cancelled states. Bookings are not invoices.
metrics.calculation: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SalesOrderID) FROM OrderService WHERE OrderDate BETWEEN :start AND :end
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SalesOrderID) FROM OrderService WHERE OrderDate BETWEEN :start AND :end
metrics.filters: Through configured business cutoff; posted invoices only where applicable
metrics.exclusions: No taxes, freight, rebates, GL balances or credit-note accounting

metrics.business_definition: Distinct customers with invoice activity in the complete dataset.
metrics.calculation: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) FROM FactSales WHERE DateKey BETWEEN :start AND :end
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) FROM FactSales WHERE DateKey BETWEEN :start AND :end
metrics.filters: Through configured business cutoff; posted invoices only where applicable
metrics.exclusions: No taxes, freight, rebates, GL balances or credit-note accounting

metrics.business_definition: Signed ending quantity times current product cost, including negative ledger positions. Not accounting valuation.
metrics.calculation: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.Quantity*p.UnitCost),0) FROM FactInventory f JOIN DimProduct p USING(ProductID)
metrics.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.Quantity*p.UnitCost),0) FROM FactInventory f JOIN DimProduct p USING(ProductID)
metrics.filters: Through configured business cutoff; posted invoices only where applicable
metrics.exclusions: No taxes, freight, rebates, GL balances or credit-note accounting

metrics.business_definition: Positive ending stock with zero shipments in trailing 90 days at current product cost. Investigation candidate, not obsolete stock.
metrics.calculation: WITH positions AS (SELECT ProductID,WarehouseID,SUM(Quantity) qty,SUM(CASE WHEN TransactionType='Sales Shipment' AND DateKey>date(:cutoff,'-' || :movement_window_days || ' days') AND DateKey<=:cutoff THEN ABS(Quantity) ELSE 0 END) shipped FROM FactInventory GROUP BY ProductID,WarehouseID) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty*p.UnitCost),0) FROM positions JOIN DimProduct p USING(ProductID) WHERE qty>0 AND shipped=0
metrics.sql: WITH positions AS (SELECT ProductID,WarehouseID,SUM(Quantity) qty,SUM(CASE WHEN TransactionType='Sales Shipment' AND DateKey>date(:cutoff,'-' || :movement_window_days || ' days') AND DateKey<=:cutoff THEN ABS(Quantity) ELSE 0 END) shipped FROM FactInventory GROUP BY ProductID,WarehouseID) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty*p.UnitCost),0) FROM positions JOIN DimProduct p USING(ProductID) WHERE qty>0 AND shipped=0
metrics.filters: Through configured business cutoff; posted invoices only where applicable
metrics.exclusions: No taxes, freight, rebates, GL balances or credit-note accounting

metrics.business_definition: Shipment units in the trailing 90-day window divided by 90; full distribution network.
metrics.calculation: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ABS(Quantity)),0)/CAST(:movement_window_days AS REAL) FROM FactInventory WHERE TransactionType='Sales Shipment' AND DateKey>date(:cutoff,'-' || :movement_window_days || ' days') AND DateKey<=:cutoff
metrics.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ABS(Quantity)),0)/CAST(:movement_window_days AS REAL) FROM FactInventory WHERE TransactionType='Sales Shipment' AND DateKey>date(:cutoff,'-' || :movement_window_days || ' days') AND DateKey<=:cutoff
metrics.filters: Through configured business cutoff; posted invoices only where applicable
metrics.exclusions: No taxes, freight, rebates, GL balances or credit-note accounting

metrics.business_definition: Customers with at least $25,000 historical invoiced revenue and more than 60 days since last invoice.
metrics.calculation: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerID FROM FactSales GROUP BY CustomerID HAVING SUM(Revenue)>=:valuable_customer_revenue AND julianday(:cutoff)-julianday(MAX(DateKey))>:inactive_days)
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerID FROM FactSales GROUP BY CustomerID HAVING SUM(Revenue)>=:valuable_customer_revenue AND julianday(:cutoff)-julianday(MAX(DateKey))>:inactive_days)
metrics.filters: Through configured business cutoff; posted invoices only where applicable
metrics.exclusions: No taxes, freight, rebates, GL balances or credit-note accounting

metrics.business_definition: Received divided by ordered quantity over all PO lines, including open lines. Not OTIF.

metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PONumber) FROM FactPurchasing WHERE RemainingQuantity>0 AND ExpectedDeliveryDate<:cutoff

metrics.business_definition: Unreceived PO line value with expected delivery date before business cutoff.

metrics.business_definition: Shipped orders meeting requested ship date divided by shipped orders. Not delivery OTIF.
metrics.calculation: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN ActualShipDate<=RequestedShipDate THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FROM OrderService WHERE ActualShipDate IS NOT NULL
metrics.sql: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN ActualShipDate<=RequestedShipDate THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) FROM OrderService WHERE ActualShipDate IS NOT NULL

metrics.exclusions: No taxes, freight, rebates, GL balances or credit-note accounting

metrics.business_definition: Mean actual ship date minus order date among shipped orders.
metrics.calculation: SELECT AVG(julianday(ActualShipDate)-julianday(OrderDate)) FROM OrderService WHERE ActualShipDate IS NOT NULL
metrics.sql: SELECT AVG(julianday(ActualShipDate)-julianday(OrderDate)) FROM OrderService WHERE ActualShipDate IS NOT NULL
